parameters.description: Equipped mystic shield, dark fantasy pixel art side-scrolling RPG item, native 24x24 pixels transparent. Full shield centered, 16 pixels wide and 20 pixels high. Simple rounded oval silhouette with smoothly stepped pixel contour. A SINGLE CLEAN CONSISTENT ANTIQUE GOLD METAL RIM, 1-2 pixels thick, broad smooth unbroken bands, NO double outlines or tiny alternating bright dark zigzags. Dark neutral outline one pixel. Purple flat recessed face with a simple restrained gold six-spoke star and one violet gem center. Three-quarter view almost frontal, gently oval, NOT an edge-on thin sliver. Quiet even shading, no strong highlight side, horizontally flip safe. Readable bold solid pixel clusters, plain outer border, no decorative teeth, no texture dithering, no scratches, no outside glow, no hand or person, no shadow on ground, no text. Fits beside a 32-pixel tall hero. All edges fully visible with transparent margins.

In-hand equipment sprite for a grounded dark fantasy pixel-art SIDE VIEW action RPG. Small round mystic shield viewed at a slight side-on three-quarter angle, an oval silhouette 18 pixels wide and 24 pixels tall centred on the 48x48 transparent canvas. Based closely on the reference: muted antique gold thin rim, dark purple recessed face, symmetrical golden six-spoked arcane star design, tiny violet central gem. Entire shield fully visible, clean outline, neutral balanced diffuse lighting so the sprite can flip horizontally without wrong highlights. Simple readable 1-pixel clusters, limited earthy purple gold palette, no strong directional shadow, no glow outside silhouette. Shield only, no hand, no character, no inventory slot, no stand, no floor, no background. A wearable small shield, not a large tower shield.

32x32 dark fantasy pixel art skill icon for Arcane Reprise: an antique gold-rimmed violet mystic shield in the center, surrounded by a clear curved lilac clockwise arc and three small bright star sparks, expressing restoring other abilities. Dark desaturated indigo background fills the entire square, subdued warm dark border, high contrast readable central silhouette, crisp native one-pixel clusters, restrained limited gold/violet palette, no text, no digits, no clock face, no UI labels. Match grounded ARPG skill icon style; not cartoon, not glossy.
